title: Hardcoded `remaining_accounts_info` prevent vault fund transfers
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium   ## Description  Saffron Vault manually constructs CPI instructions to call Orca Whirlpool's V2 instructions (`collect_fees_v2`, `increase_liquidity_v2`, `decrease_liquidity_v2`). In the CPI wrappers, the `remaining_accounts_info` parameter is hardcoded to `None` (i.e. `data.push(0)`), and no `remaining_accounts` are passed:  ```rust // programs/saffron-vault/src/cpi/orca.rs L757-759 let mut data = Vec::with_capacity(8 + 1); data.extend_from_slice(&COLLECT_FEES_V2_DISCRIMINATOR); data.push(0); // remaining_accounts_info: None
